questions.question: What does a shape of (3, 41) mean in the batch-major solver?
options: Three independent initial conditions, each with the initial state plus forty updates.
Three time points, each with forty-one parameters.
questions.explanation: vmap contributes the leading independent-experiment axis. The scalar solve contributes its forty-one saved states; no device placement is specified.
optionFeedback: vmap contributes the leading independent-experiment axis. The scalar solve contributes its forty-one saved states; no device placement is specified.
The first axis indexes initial conditions, not times. The second includes the initial value and forty subsequent states.
A batch dimension does not imply device placement. Inspect array sharding separately from its logical shape.
